label: GO after a rewarded S2 trial; biggest after rare a1->S2 reward when belief favored S1, early-mid episode
terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * tv("belief", -1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * tv("belief", -1) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * tv("belief", -1) * ep_dec
explanation: Fires only at GO (zero at D1/D2). Magnitude is set by the previous trial: large (~+0.35 over timing) when the previous trial reached S2 and was rewarded (a2 S2 r or a1 S2 r, i.e. the evidence that points to choosing a2), and below the GO timing baseline after any unrewarded trial (~-0.08). The S2-rewarded effect shrinks later in the episode (ep_dec slope negative, consistent with timing falloff after ~trial 70). The largest spikes (~1.4-1.5) come at the GO right after a rare a1->S2 rewarded trial that followed a run of a1/S1 trials, i.e. when the prior belief favored S1 and the agent switches to a2; adding the pre-trial belief (tv belief -1) x episode decile for this case captures a little of that. Trial-before patterns and belief change add almost nothing. Observed-only terms reach dev R^2 0.37 beyond timing (all observed reference 0.38, all ceiling 0.42); the earlier model-based description (choosing a2) is mostly recovered by the S2-rewarded previous-trial cue, so little is lost. Remaining misses are spike heights (under-predicted by ~1.0) in the switch-to-a2 cases and graded GO activity during a1 runs.
